title: Benchmarking Web Agent Defenses Against Adaptive Visual Prompt Injection
abstract: arXiv:2611.29268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal web agents automate website interactions but remain vulnerable to visual prompt injection (VPI), where malicious webpage content manipulates their visual processing and induces unintended actions. Although several defenses focus on detecting injected instructions in screenshots, malicious destinations such as phishing URLs embedded in HTML can remain hidden yet accessible through agent interactions. Existing evaluations have also not sufficiently examined adaptive attackers who know the defense mechanisms. To address these limitations, we introduce AdaptiveVPI, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating adaptive VPI threats in web agents. Specifically, we present a dataset of 360 webpage instances spanning 6 distinct hijack strategies across 10 real-world websites, with malicious destinations not visible in screenshots. translated_title: 针对自适应视觉提示注入的Web代理防御基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态网页代理能够自动化网站交互，但仍然容易受到视觉提示注入（VPI）的攻击——恶意网页内容会操纵代理的视觉处理过程并诱导其执行非预期操作。尽管现有的一些防御方法专注于检测截图中注入的指令，但嵌入在HTML中的恶意目标（如钓鱼URL）可能保持隐藏状态，却能通过代理交互被访问。此外，现有评估也未充分检验那些了解防御机制的自适应攻击者。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了AdaptiveVPI，这是首个系统评估网页代理中自适应VPI威胁的基准测试。具体而言，我们构建了一个包含360个网页实例的数据集，涵盖10个真实世界网站上的6种不同劫持策略，其中恶意目标在截图中不可见。我们设计了一个自适应攻击框架，该框架基于反馈迭代地优化恶意指令……
tldr: 本文提出了首个系统评估网页代理防御能力的基准测试AdaptiveVPI，通过包含360个网页实例、6种劫持策略、10个真实网站的数据集以及基于反馈迭代的自适应攻击框架，填补了现有评估未能检验自适应攻击者与隐藏恶意目标的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AdaptiveVPI, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating web agent defenses against adaptive visual prompt injection, featuring a dataset of 360 webpage instances spanning 6 hijack strategies across 10 real-world websites with hidden malicious destinations, and an adaptive attack framework that iteratively refines malicious instructions based on feedback.
